# Determine the last two competitions based on the year column
# Sort by year descending to get the most recent competitions
sorted_df = df.sort_values(by='year', ascending=False)

# Get the last two competitions (two most recent years)
last_two = sorted_df.head(2)

# Extract the distance values from the 'notes' column for these competitions
# The distance is the numeric part before the space and 'm'
distances = last_two['notes'].str.extract(r'(\d+\.\d+)')[0].astype(float)

# Calculate the average of these distances
average_distance = distances.mean()

# Check if the average equals 78.27 (with a small tolerance for floating point)
answer = abs(average_distance - 78.27) < 1e-9
